camel_example: aliyun winnexo POST /openapi/deleteAppResourcePermissions --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'items=[{resourceKey=app.demo.resource_1, scope=RESOURCE, resourceType=APP_RESOURCE}]' --version 2026-05-12 --force
description_en: Deletes multiple resource permissions within an application
description_zh: 批量删除应用内资源权限
name: DeleteAppResourcePermissions

parameters.help_en: The platform application token issued by the console. If specified, the operation is executed as the user identified by opsUserId or opsUserCode
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用 Token（控制台签发）。传入后将以 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定的用户身份执行
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The proxy user ID, which is the WINNEXO platform user ID. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as winnexo_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID），仅当应用凭证配置为 winnexo_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The proxy user code, which is unique within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as source_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户编码（租户内唯一），仅当应用凭证配置为 source_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant to which the resource belongs. If omitted, the current tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属租户 ID；省略为调用人当前租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

fields.help_en: The list of grantee principal IDs
fields.help_zh: GRANTEE 主体 ID 列表
fields.name: grantee_ids

fields.help_en: The tenant to which the grantee user belongs. This parameter can be omitted if the user belongs to the same tenant as the resource, and is required for cross-tenant users
fields.help_zh: GRANTEE USER 所属租户；同资源租户可省略，跨租户 USER 必填
fields.name: grantee_tenant_id

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to include dot-separated descendant resources for the RESOURCE scope. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: RESOURCE 是否包含点分后代资源；省略为 false
fields.name: include_descendants

fields.help_en: The dot-separated resource key whose first segment is the APP application key
fields.help_zh: 首段为 APP 应用键的点分资源键
fields.name: resource_key

fields.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to APP_RESOURCE
fields.name: resource_type

fields.help_en: The deletion scope, which can be by resource or by principal
fields.help_zh: 删除范围：按资源或按主体
fields.name: scope

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

deletedCount.description_en: The number of deleted permission records

message.description_en: The error description. This field is empty if the request is successful
